description: Curated, documented breaking API changes in popular packages. Each rule names the call it affects and a machine-checkable condition. Sources: upstream changelogs.

rules.description: PyJWT 2.0 requires the `algorithms` argument for jwt.decode(); calls without it raise DecodeError.
rules.fix: Pass an explicit allow-list, e.g. algorithms=["HS256"].

rules.description: jwt.encode() returns str instead of bytes since 2.0; calling .decode() on the result raises AttributeError.
rules.fix: Drop the .decode('utf-8') call on the token.

rules.description: The `verify` argument of jwt.decode() was removed in 2.0.
rules.fix: Use options={"verify_signature": False} only where intended (tests).

rules.description: @validator is deprecated in Pydantic 2 in favour of @field_validator (different signature).

rules.fix: Run initialisation code during application setup instead.
